mu_name_from: Object2/Rat01.bmd, which is not a placement: MoveFishs gives the fish slot MODEL_RAT01 in the Dungeon (GOBoid.cpp:1720-1722) and keeps three around whoever is playing, on floor tiles only. Named in tools/cook.py's AIRS beside the bat.
why_this_one: The Dungeon's rats: 36 triangles, 6 bones, a 5-key run. They dash in bursts at 0.6/scale units a frame, turn back at the void and stop to sit, scale 0.4 to 0.7, one in 256 frames within six tiles squeaking aMouse.wav (GOBoid.cpp:1659-1860).
